title_zh: 约定活动排队拥堵时的联络与候场安排

scenario.label_zh: 约定活动排队拥堵时的处理安排
scenario.goal_zh: 识别排队冲突升级的风险，并约定联系值班经理和使用室内候场区

context_zh: 两名活动工作人员在开场前检查接待队伍可能拥堵的情况。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: Last year the queue blocked the pavement. Repeating that would be disastrous for tonight's event.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Especially if an argument starts and other people join in. A small complaint can escalate quickly.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: What should we do if confusion does ensue at the entrance?

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Call the duty manager rather than trying to settle a crowd argument alone.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: And where can people wait without blocking the street?

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: The venue has approved the indoor waiting area. The manager can open it when the outside queue reaches the marked point.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: All right. I will watch that point and call the manager before the pavement becomes blocked.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Good. I will keep the entrance clear and direct people once the manager opens the waiting area.
